factories.name: new_list_contacts_step
factories.description: List one bounded page of contacts, at most 100, filtered by a case-insensitive search term, contact IDs, and modification time, with Xero's page count.

inputSchema.description: ListContactsInput filters one page of contacts. Every filter is optional, and filters combine.

contactIds.description: ContactIDs limits the page to at most 40 contacts by their Xero UUIDs.

includesArchived.description: IncludesArchived also returns ARCHIVED contacts, which Xero leaves out by default.

modifiedSince.description: ModifiedSince sends If-Modified-Since, so only contacts created or changed at or after this instant, to the second, are returned. Xero does not count balance or IsCustomer changes.

page.description: Page is the 1-based page to read; zero reads the first page.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to 100 contacts; zero uses DefaultPageSize.

searchTerm.description: SearchTerm is a case-insensitive text search across Name, FirstName, LastName, ContactNumber, CompanyNumber, and EmailAddress; blank lists every contact.

factories.name: new_find_contact_by_email_step
factories.description: Resolve one contact by its exact email address with Xero's optimised EmailAddress filter, distinguishing one match, none, and several.

inputSchema.description: FindContactByEmailInput identifies a contact by its email address.

emailAddress.description: EmailAddress is one bare address such as jane@example.com. Xero's filter ignores case and accents; the connector then keeps only contacts whose address equals it, ignoring case.

includesArchived.description: IncludesArchived also matches ARCHIVED contacts, which cannot be invoiced; false matches only the contacts Xero lists by default.

factories.name: new_get_invoice_step
factories.description: Read one sales invoice or bill by InvoiceID or invoice number, with its line items, exact decimal totals, amounts due and paid, and applied payments.

inputSchema.description: GetInvoiceInput identifies one invoice by exactly one of its identifiers.

invoiceNumber.description: InvoiceNumber is the document number, such as INV-0042, used when InvoiceID is blank.

factories.name: new_list_invoices_step
factories.description: List one bounded page of invoices, at most 100 with line items, filtered by Xero status, contact, type, exact reference, and If-Modified-Since time, with Xero's page count.

inputSchema.description: ListInvoicesInput filters one page of invoices. Every filter is optional, and filters combine.

contactIds.description: ContactIDs keeps invoices for any of at most 40 contacts, by Xero UUID.

invoiceNumbers.description: InvoiceNumbers keeps invoices with any of at most 40 document numbers.

modifiedSince.description: ModifiedSince sends If-Modified-Since, so only invoices created or changed at or after this instant, to the second, are returned. Xero does not count every change, such as a due date changed on a partly paid invoice.

page.description: Page is the 1-based page to read; zero reads the first page.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to 100 invoices; zero uses DefaultPageSize.

reference.description: Reference keeps invoices whose Reference equals this value, through Xero's optimised filter.

statuses.description: Statuses keeps invoices in any of these Xero statuses; empty keeps every status.

type.description: Type keeps only ACCREC sales invoices or ACCPAY bills; blank keeps both.

factories.name: new_create_invoice_step
factories.description: Create one sales invoice or bill for a contact with exact decimal line amounts, a currency, a reference, and an optional invoice number; every attempt of the Step sends the same Xero Idempotency-Key, so a repeated dispatch returns the first invoice instead of creating another.

InvoiceLineItemInput.description: InvoiceLineItemInput is one line of a new invoice.

accountCode.description: AccountCode is the chart-of-accounts code, such as 200; Xero requires one to approve.

discountRate.description: DiscountRate is a percentage from 0 to 100 on an ACCREC line; ACCPAY lines take none.

itemCode.description: ItemCode is an inventory item code, which can supply the description and price.

quantity.description: Quantity is the line quantity, up to four decimal places; blank leaves it to Xero or the item.

taxType.description: TaxType overrides the account's default Xero tax type, such as OUTPUT or NONE.

unitAmount.description: UnitAmount is the unit price, up to four decimal places, which Xero keeps because the connector sends unitdp=4; blank leaves it to Xero or the item.

inputSchema.description: CreateInvoiceInput describes one new sales invoice or bill. Amounts are exact Decimals in the invoice's currency and are sent to Xero as the same number literals.

brandingThemeId.description: BrandingThemeID is the Xero UUID of a branding theme; blank uses the organisation's default.

contactId.description: ContactID is the Xero UUID of the customer or supplier, such as from findContactByEmail. Xero is sent only this ID, so the contact record is never changed.

currencyCode.description: CurrencyCode is an ISO 4217 code enabled in the organisation, such as USD; blank uses the organisation's base currency.

date.description: Date is the issue date, YYYY-MM-DD; blank uses today in the organisation's time zone.

dueDate.description: DueDate is the due date, YYYY-MM-DD; Xero requires one to approve a sales invoice.

invoiceNumber.description: InvoiceNumber is the document number. Blank lets Xero number an ACCREC invoice from the organisation's invoice settings; an ACCREC number must be unique.

lineAmountTypes.description: LineAmountTypes is Exclusive, Inclusive, or NoTax; blank means Exclusive.

lineItems.description: LineItems are 1 to 100 lines, each with a description.

reference.description: Reference is an additional reference, such as the application's order ID; listInvoices can find the invoice by it.

status.description: Status is DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or AUTHORISED; blank means DRAFT. Only an AUTHORISED invoice can take a payment.

type.description: Type is ACCREC for a sales invoice or ACCPAY for a bill.

factories.name: new_record_payment_step
factories.description: Record one payment of an exact decimal amount against an approved invoice from a bank or payment-enabled account; every attempt of the Step sends the same Xero Idempotency-Key, so a repeated dispatch returns the first payment instead of paying twice.

inputSchema.description: RecordPaymentInput is one payment against an approved invoice.

accountCode.description: AccountCode is that account's code, such as 090, for accounts that have one.

accountId.description: AccountID is the Xero UUID of a BANK account, or of an account with payments enabled. Set exactly one of AccountID and AccountCode.

amount.description: Amount is the payment in the invoice's currency, with at most two decimal places; it must not exceed the invoice's amount due.

bankAmount.description: BankAmount is the amount in the account's currency for a multicurrency payment, which Xero prefers to a rate; blank lets Xero apply its rate.

date.description: Date is the payment date, YYYY-MM-DD.

invoiceId.description: InvoiceID is the Xero UUID of an AUTHORISED invoice or bill.

isReconciled.description: IsReconciled marks the payment reconciled without a bank statement line, for conversions.

reference.description: Reference is an optional description, such as the card processor's charge ID.
